# Vocabahn

German vocabulary learning app: a shared AI-enriched dictionary, FSRS spaced-repetition flashcards, and curated courses — built as a mobile-first PWA with an AI-first knowledge model architecture.

## About this Project
Vocabahn is an AI-first language learning platform. It combines traditional spaced-repetition algorithms (FSRS) with deep LLM enrichment, comprehensible input micro-stories, production drills, and a deterministic session planner.

## Tech Stack
- Backend: NestJS 11, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query, GSAP
- Shared: Zod schemas (`packages/shared/`)
